+import uuid
+from datetime import datetime
+from typing import Optional
+from sqlalchemy import (
+    Column,
+    String,
+    Text,
+    DateTime,
+    ForeignKey,
+    Boolean,
+    Integer,
+    Float,
+    UniqueConstraint,
+)
+from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
+
+Base = declarative_base()
+
+
+def generate_uuid() -> str:
+    return str(uuid.uuid4())
+
+
+class User(Base):
+    __tablename__ = "users"
+
+    id = Column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=generate_uuid)
+    email = Column(String(255), unique=True, index=True, nullable=False)
+    password_hash = Column(String(255), nullable=True)
+    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, nullable=False)
+
+    documents = relationship("Document", back_populates="user", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
+    generated_exams = relationship("GeneratedExam", back_populates="user", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
+    exam_sessions = relationship("ExamSession", back_populates="user", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
+    mastery_records = relationship("LongitudinalMastery", back_populates="user", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
+
+
+class Document(Base):
+    __tablename__ = "documents"
+
+    id = Column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=generate_uuid)
+    user_id = Column(String(36), ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=True)
+    title = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
+    doc_type = Column(String(50), nullable=False)  # EXAM_SAMPLE, LECTURE_NOTE, SLIDE_DECK
+    storage_path = Column(String(512), nullable=True)
+    parsed_text = Column(Text, nullable=True)
+    status = Column(String(30), default="PENDING", nullable=False)  # PENDING, PARSED, FAILED
+    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, nullable=False)
+
+    user = relationship("User", back_populates="documents")
+    blueprints = relationship("ExamBlueprint", back_populates="source_document", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
+
+
+class ExamBlueprint(Base):
+    __tablename__ = "exam_blueprints"
+
+    id = Column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=generate_uuid)
+    source_document_id = Column(String(36), ForeignKey("documents.id"), nullable=False)
+    blueprint_json = Column(Text, nullable=False)
+    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, nullable=False)
+
+    source_document = relationship("Document", back_populates="blueprints")
+    generated_exams = relationship("GeneratedExam", back_populates="source_blueprint")
+
+
+class GeneratedExam(Base):
+    __tablename__ = "generated_exams"
+
+    id = Column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=generate_uuid)
+    user_id = Column(String(36), ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=True)
+    source_blueprint_id = Column(String(36), ForeignKey("exam_blueprints.id"), nullable=True)
+    title = Column(String(255), nullable=False)
+    is_adaptive = Column(Boolean, default=False, nullable=False)
+    status = Column(String(30), default="GENERATING", nullable=False)  # GENERATING, READY, FAILED
+    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, nullable=False)
+
+    user = relationship("User", back_populates="generated_exams")
+    source_blueprint = relationship("ExamBlueprint", back_populates="generated_exams")
+    questions = relationship("Question", back_populates="exam", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
+    sessions = relationship("ExamSession", back_populates="exam", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
+
+
+class Question(Base):
+    __tablename__ = "questions"
+
+    id = Column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=generate_uuid)
+    exam_id = Column(String(36), ForeignKey("generated_exams.id"), nullable=False)
+    topic_id = Column(String(100), index=True, nullable=False)
+    question_type = Column(String(30), nullable=False)  # MULTIPLE_CHOICE, SHORT_ANSWER, ESSAY
+    difficulty = Column(String(20), nullable=False)  # BASIC, INTERMEDIATE, ADVANCED
+    prompt = Column(Text, nullable=False)
+    options_json = Column(Text, nullable=True)
+    expected_answer = Column(Text, nullable=False)
+    grading_rubric = Column(Text, nullable=True)
+    points = Column(Integer, default=1, nullable=False)
+    similarity_score = Column(Float, nullable=True)
+
+    exam = relationship("GeneratedExam", back_populates="questions")
+    answers = relationship("ExamAnswer", back_populates="question", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
+
+
+class ExamSession(Base):
+    __tablename__ = "exam_sessions"
+
+    id = Column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=generate_uuid)
+    exam_id = Column(String(36), ForeignKey("generated_exams.id"), nullable=False)
+    user_id = Column(String(36), ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=True)
+    started_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, nullable=False)
+    submitted_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=True)
+    total_score = Column(Float, nullable=True)
+    max_possible_score = Column(Float, nullable=True)
+

+    answers = relationship("ExamAnswer", back_populates="session", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
+
+
+class ExamAnswer(Base):
+    __tablename__ = "exam_answers"
+
+    id = Column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=generate_uuid)
+    session_id = Column(String(36), ForeignKey("exam_sessions.id"), nullable=False)
+    question_id = Column(String(36), ForeignKey("questions.id"), nullable=False)
+    student_response = Column(Text, nullable=True)
+    score_awarded = Column(Float, nullable=True)
+    feedback_text = Column(Text, nullable=True)
+    graded_at = Column(DateTime, nullable=True)
+
+    session = relationship("ExamSession", back_populates="answers")
+    question = relationship("Question", back_populates="answers")
+
+
+class LongitudinalMastery(Base):
+    __tablename__ = "longitudinal_mastery"
+    __table_args__ = (UniqueConstraint("user_id", "topic", name="uq_user_topic"),)
+
+    id = Column(String(36), primary_key=True, default=generate_uuid)
+    user_id = Column(String(36), ForeignKey("users.id"), nullable=False)
+    topic = Column(String(100), index=True, nullable=False)
+    total_attempts = Column(Integer, default=0, nullable=False)
+    successful_attempts = Column(Integer, default=0, nullable=False)
+    mastery_rating = Column(Float, default=0.0, nullable=False)
+    last_assessed_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.utcnow, nullable=False)
+
+    user = relationship("User", back_populates="mastery_records")

+from typing import List, Optional
+from fastapi import FastAPI, status
+from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
+
+app = FastAPI(
+    title="AI-Powered Adaptive Exam Preparation System API",
+    version="1.0.0",
+    description="Service contracts for AI integration, document processing, and adaptive exam workflows.",
+)
+
+
+class DocumentUploadResponse(BaseModel):
+    document_id: str
+    status: str
+    message: str
+
+
+class DocumentDetailResponse(BaseModel):
+    document_id: str
+    title: str
+    doc_type: str
+    status: str
+    extracted_char_count: Optional[int] = None
+    created_at: str
+
+
+class JobAcceptedResponse(BaseModel):
+    job_id: str
+
+
+class JobStatusResponse(BaseModel):
+    job_id: str
+    status: str
+    progress_percentage: int
+    result_id: Optional[str] = None
+    error: Optional[str] = None
+
+
+class GenerateExamRequest(BaseModel):
+    source_blueprint_id: Optional[str] = None
+    study_document_ids: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
+    adaptive_mode: bool = False
+
+
+class QuestionItem(BaseModel):
+    question_id: str
+    sequence_order: int
+    question_type: str
+    prompt: str
+    options: Optional[List[str]] = None
+    points: int
+
+
+class ExamDetailResponse(BaseModel):
+    exam_id: str
+    title: str
+    total_questions: int
+    questions: List[QuestionItem]
+
+
+class CreateSessionResponse(BaseModel):
+    session_id: str
+    started_at: str
+
+
+class StudentAnswerSubmission(BaseModel):
+    question_id: str
+    student_answer: str
+
+
+class SaveAnswersRequest(BaseModel):
+    answers: List[StudentAnswerSubmission]
+
+
+class SaveAnswersResponse(BaseModel):
+    status: str
+    last_saved_at: str
+
+
+class QuestionEvaluation(BaseModel):
+    question_id: str
+    score: float
+    max_score: float
+    is_correct: bool
+    feedback: str
+
+
+class ExamSessionReportResponse(BaseModel):
+    session_id: str
+    total_score: float
+    earned_score: float
+    evaluations: List[QuestionEvaluation]
+
+
+class StudySummarizeRequest(BaseModel):
+    document_id: str
+    focus_topics: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
+
+
+class StudySummarizeResponse(BaseModel):
+    summary: str
+    key_points: List[str]
+    formulas: List[str]
+
+
+class TopicMasteryDetail(BaseModel):
+    topic: str
+    mastery_score: float
+    status: str
+
+
+class RecommendationItem(BaseModel):
+    topic: str
+    suggested_action: str
+    reference_document_id: Optional[str] = None
+
+
+class ReadinessDiagnosticsResponse(BaseModel):
+    overall_readiness_percentage: float
+    topic_mastery: List[TopicMasteryDetail]
+    recommendations: List[RecommendationItem]
+
+
+@app.get("/api/v1/health", tags=["System"])
+def health_check():
+    return {"status": "ok"}
+
+
+@app.post("/api/v1/documents", status_code=status.HTTP_202_ACCEPTED, response_model=DocumentUploadResponse, tags=["Ingestion"])
+def upload_document():
+    return DocumentUploadResponse(document_id="doc_placeholder", status="PROCESSING", message="File accepted for extraction.")
+
+
+@app.get("/api/v1/documents/{document_id}", response_model=DocumentDetailResponse, tags=["Ingestion"])
+def get_document(document_id: str):
+    return DocumentDetailResponse(
+        document_id=document_id,
+        title="example.pdf",
+        doc_type="EXAM_SAMPLE",
+        status="READY",
+        extracted_char_count=0,
+        created_at="2025-10-12T10:00:00Z",
+    )
+
+
+@app.post("/api/v1/documents/{document_id}/decompose", status_code=status.HTTP_202_ACCEPTED, response_model=JobAcceptedResponse, tags=["Decomposition"])
+def decompose_document(document_id: str):
+    return JobAcceptedResponse(job_id="job_placeholder")
+
+
+@app.get("/api/v1/jobs/{job_id}", response_model=JobStatusResponse, tags=["Jobs"])
+def get_job_status(job_id: str):
+    return JobStatusResponse(job_id=job_id, status="PENDING", progress_percentage=0)
+
+
+@app.post("/api/v1/exams/generate", status_code=status.HTTP_202_ACCEPTED, response_model=JobAcceptedResponse, tags=["Exams"])
+def generate_exam(req: GenerateExamRequest):
+    return JobAcceptedResponse(job_id="job_placeholder")
+
+
+@app.get("/api/v1/exams/{exam_id}", response_model=ExamDetailResponse, tags=["Exams"])
+def get_exam(exam_id: str):
+    return ExamDetailResponse(exam_id=exam_id, title="Sample Exam", total_questions=0, questions=[])
+
+
+@app.post("/api/v1/exams/{exam_id}/sessions", status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED, response_model=CreateSessionResponse, tags=["Execution"])
+def create_exam_session(exam_id: str):
+    return CreateSessionResponse(session_id="sess_placeholder", started_at="2025-10-12T14:30:00Z")
+
+
+@app.put("/api/v1/exams/sessions/{session_id}/answers", response_model=SaveAnswersResponse, tags=["Execution"])
+def save_answers(session_id: str, req: SaveAnswersRequest):
+    return SaveAnswersResponse(status="SAVED", last_saved_at="2025-10-12T14:45:10Z")
+
+
+@app.post("/api/v1/exams/sessions/{session_id}/submit", status_code=status.HTTP_202_ACCEPTED, response_model=JobAcceptedResponse, tags=["Execution"])
+def submit_exam_session(session_id: str):
+    return JobAcceptedResponse(job_id="job_eval_placeholder")
+
+
+@app.get("/api/v1/exams/sessions/{session_id}/report", response_model=ExamSessionReportResponse, tags=["Execution"])
+def get_session_report(session_id: str):
+    return ExamSessionReportResponse(session_id=session_id, total_score=0.0, earned_score=0.0, evaluations=[])
+
+
+@app.post("/api/v1/study/summarize", response_model=StudySummarizeResponse, tags=["Study Synthesis"])
+def summarize_study_material(req: StudySummarizeRequest):
+    return StudySummarizeResponse(summary="", key_points=[], formulas=[])
+
+
+@app.get("/api/v1/diagnostics/readiness", response_model=ReadinessDiagnosticsResponse, tags=["Diagnostics"])
+def get_readiness_diagnostics():
+    return ReadinessDiagnosticsResponse(overall_readiness_percentage=0.0, topic_mastery=[], recommendations=[])

+import pytest
+from pilot.app.backend.main import app
+from pilot.app.backend.models import (
+    Base,
+    User,
+    Document,
+    ExamBlueprint,
+    GeneratedExam,
+    Question,
+    ExamSession,
+    ExamAnswer,
+    LongitudinalMastery,
+)
+
+
+def test_openapi_schema_generation():
+    schema = app.openapi()
+    assert schema["info"]["title"] == "AI-Powered Adaptive Exam Preparation System API"
+    assert "/api/v1/documents" in schema["paths"]
+    assert "/api/v1/exams/generate" in schema["paths"]
+    assert "/api/v1/exams/{exam_id}" in schema["paths"]
+    assert "/api/v1/exams/sessions/{session_id}/report" in schema["paths"]
+    assert "/api/v1/diagnostics/readiness" in schema["paths"]
+
+
+def test_sqlalchemy_model_table_names():
+    assert User.__tablename__ == "users"
+    assert Document.__tablename__ == "documents"
+    assert ExamBlueprint.__tablename__ == "exam_blueprints"
+    assert GeneratedExam.__tablename__ == "generated_exams"
+    assert Question.__tablename__ == "questions"
+    assert ExamSession.__tablename__ == "exam_sessions"
+    assert ExamAnswer.__tablename__ == "exam_answers"
+    assert LongitudinalMastery.__tablename__ == "longitudinal_mastery"
+    
+    expected_tables = {
+        "users",
+        "documents",
+        "exam_blueprints",
+        "generated_exams",
+        "questions",
+        "exam_sessions",
+        "exam_answers",
+        "longitudinal_mastery",
+    }
+    assert set(Base.metadata.tables.keys()) == expected_tables
